# rintup_status_page (Resource)

A public status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rintup_status_page" "public" {
  title       = "Acme Status"
  slug        = "acme"
  description = "Live status of Acme services"
  brand_color = "#0F766E"
  locale      = "en"

  allow_subscriptions          = true
  notify_subscribers_on_outage = true

  # Display order = list order. display_name defaults to the monitor's name.
  components = [
    { monitor_id = rintup_monitor.api.id, display_name = "API", group = "Core" },
    { monitor_id = rintup_monitor.home.id, display_name = "Website" },
  ]
}

# A private page: the password is write-only (never stored in state).
variable "status_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "rintup_status_page" "internal" {
  title               = "Acme Internal"
  noindex             = true
  password_wo         = var.status_password
  password_wo_version = "1" # bump to set a new password; remove both to drop the protection
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Page title (1-120 characters).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allow_subscriptions` (Boolean) Visitors may subscribe by e-mail (double opt-in). Default: `false`.
- `brand_color` (String) Brand colour `#RRGGBB`.
- `components` (Attributes List) Components in display order; each shows one monitor. The list replaces the page's components as a whole. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components))
- `custom_domain` (String) Custom domain such as status.example.com (plan feature; verified with a TXT record).
- `description` (String) Short description on the page.
- `locale` (String) Page language: `en` or `tr`. Default: `en`.
- `logo_url` (String) Logo address (https).
- `noindex` (Boolean) Ask search engines not to index the page. Default: `false`.
- `notify_subscribers_on_outage` (Boolean) E-mail subscribers automatically when a component goes down or recovers. Default: `false`.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Page password: visitors must enter it. Removing it together with its version removes the protection. Write-only: never stored in state. Change `password_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Any value (e.g. `1` or a date). When it changes, `password_wo` is sent again; when it is removed together with the secret, the stored secret is deleted.
- `show_response_times` (Boolean) Show response times. Default: `true`.
- `slug` (String) Address: status.rintup.com/{slug}; 3-48 lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Default: derived from the title.

### Read-Only

- `custom_domain_verified` (Boolean) The custom domain's TXT record was verified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password_protected` (Boolean) The page asks visitors for a password.

<a id="nestedatt--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components`

Required:

- `monitor_id` (String) Monitor id (same workspace).

Optional:

- `display_name` (String) Name on the page. Default: the monitor's name.
- `group` (String) Group heading.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rintup_status_page.public 0192f3a4-5b6c-7d8e-9f00-112233445566
```
